description: This file contains a JSON parser implementation based on a stream parsing approach. It provides functions to initialize, destruct, change callbacks, and parse JSON data incrementally, handling various JSON constructs such as objects, arrays, strings, numbers, and literals with detailed error handling. The parser uses a context structure to manage stream state and supports path matching for specific JSON keys.

methods.name: void lejp_construct(struct lejp_ctx * ctx,signed char (* callback)(struct lejp_ctx * ctx,char reason),void * user,const char * const * paths,unsigned char count_paths)
methods.description: Initializes the JSON parser context with callback, user data, and paths of interest.

methods.name: void lejp_destruct(struct lejp_ctx * ctx)
methods.description: Cleans up the parser context, invoking a callback to signal destruction.

methods.name: void lejp_change_callback(struct lejp_ctx * ctx,signed char (* callback)(struct lejp_ctx * ctx,char reason))
methods.description: Switches the callback handler during parsing to allow context-specific handling.

methods.name: void lejp_check_path_match(struct lejp_ctx * ctx)
methods.description: Checks whether the current JSON path matches any user-defined interest paths.

methods.name: int lejp_get_wildcard(struct lejp_ctx * ctx,int wildcard,char * dest,int len)
methods.description: Retrieves a wildcard portion of a matched path.

methods.name: int lejp_parse(struct lejp_ctx * ctx,const unsigned char * json,int len)
methods.description: Incrementally parses incoming JSON data, handling partial data streams, and calls user callbacks on specific tokens or structures.

methods.name: lejp_parser_push
methods.description: Pushes a new parsing context onto the stack for nested objects or arrays.

methods.name: lejp_parser_pop
methods.description: Pops the current parsing context from the stack, returning to the previous context.

methods.name: lejp_error_to_string
methods.description: Converts parser error codes into human-readable strings.
